title: To JSON
description: Convert an object to a JSON representation.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Name of the output column. If omitted, the input column will be overwritten.

parameters.name: ensure_ascii
parameters.description: If true, non-ASCII characters will be escaped. Default is false.

parameters.name: indent
parameters.description: If indent is a non-negative integer or string, then JSON array elements and object members will be pretty-printed with that indent level. An indent level of 0, negative, or "" will only insert newlines. None (the default) selects the most compact representation. Using a positive integer indent indents that many spaces per level. If indent is a string (such as '\t'), that string is used to indent each level.

parameters.name: sort_keys
parameters.description: If sort_keys is true (defaults to False), then the output of dictionaries will be sorted by key.

parameters.name: if
parameters.description: Condition that determines whether the wrangle runs as a whole. Recipe variables may be referenced with `${variable}`.

parameters.name: where
parameters.description: Filter rows before applying the wrangle using SQL-like criteria, such as `column1 = 123 OR column2 = 'abc'`.

parameters.name: where_params
parameters.description: Values used with `where` for parameterized criteria. Uses SQLite placeholder syntax such as `?` or `:name`.

guidance:
Convert an object to a JSON representation. ## Migrated examples #### Convert Text to JSON ##### Recipe ```yaml wrangles: - convert.to_json: input: column output: new column ```
##### Input Sample | column | | --- | | `['a', 'python', 'list']` | | `{'python': 'dict'}` |
##### Output Sample | new column | | --- | | `["a","python","list"]` | | `{"python":"dict"}` |
